note:
R121 - continuity of the remaining title-free (unscoped) player enums in defs/enums, on the R120 matching (K1 = name + calendar birth
date; same pairs): eye colour (`ubPc.eyecolorcode`), skin colour (`ubPc.skincolor`), skater style (`dSvy` p_style / playerstyle) and goalie style
(`mHuy` g_style / playerstyle), joined to the bio row by game_id. Per source: metadata and value distribution; per pair: share unchanged and
systematic code moves (a code whose players mostly carry another code on the next title). Continuity only - no title-owned labels were
found for these fields; a systematic move flags a possible renumbering, a stable map is supporting evidence, neither is proof.
Usage: python r121_unscoped_enum_continuity.py <out.json>
